checks.label: A normal distribution with k = 2 gives an interval with a coverage probability of approximately 95%: the normal curve holds 95.4% within 2 SD of its mean, and 2,000 readings from the rule on screen land within 2 SD of their batch's mean about 95% of the time

Some 99.7% of a normal population lies within 3 standard deviations of the mean, so a value further than about 3.3 standard deviations from the mean may be treated as an outlier: the normal curve holds 99.7% within 3 SD; slipped 1.2 V the ringed reading sits 4.0 SD from the mean of the others, beyond 3.3, and slipped 0.6 V it sits 2.0 SD out

Worked by hand from the opening batch: mean 114.98 V and SD 0.31 V; 33, 48 and 49 of the 50 within 1, 2 and 3 SD, near the 34, 2 or 3 beyond 2 SD, and 50 the curve expects; one reading past the example limits, at 115.9 V, and one past limits 2 SD out; the limits 0.8 V from 115.0 V, about 2.7 SD; a reading on a limit is in; 116.0 V about 3.3 SD from the mean of the fifty and 116.2 V about 4.0; one reading above 115.6 V; twelve nudges reach at most 6 SD; about one batch in five of fifty honest readings has one past the example limits; the leaning insulation resistance swarm has mean 212.5 MΩ and SD 79.4 MΩ, with 2 of its 50 (4%) more than 2 SD above the mean, at 378 and 455 MΩ, and none that far below

Drawn true: settled, the fulcrum sits under the mean and the beam is level at every slip; each limit line sits on the outer edge of its limit's column, so every bead past a line is counted out and every one counted is past a line; the pointer sits at the ringed reading's count of SDs on the ruler; a reading past the scale sits in its overflow pile, named, never clipped; no two beads touch, every bead inside its room, none under r 3.2, at every slip and over 200 fresh batches; the mean's value clears every bead; the fade deepest at 3:1 and palest still seen; no dashed line runs through a label

Each puzzle accepts only its right answer of three, and before an answer nothing in its picture gives it away: no farthest path, no 2 SD band, no pointer over the new reading, no normal curve or 2 SD band round the leaning swarm; a right answer brings each in. Every demonstration settles within 5 s, the pour with its rise and its curve among them, and every answer's motion within 2.5 s
